```{r}
#| results: asis
library(knitr)
source("scripts/shared.R")

senators <- load_senators()
ns       <- senator_name_sets(senators)
votes    <- load_all_votes(ns)
bills    <- load_bills() |> bill_statuses(votes)

# Bills' committee names -> codes for docket matching
bills$committee_code <- sapply(bills$committee, committee_code_from_name)

# One tab per committee, plus the Floor. Each tab shows the membership,
# the latest agenda, the docket (bills awaiting action there), and the
# most recent votes taken.
sync_intake_agendas()
agenda_files <- list.files(AGENDAS_DIR, pattern = "\\.pdf$")

cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")

for (code in names(COMMITTEE_NAMES)) {
  cat("##", COMMITTEE_NAMES[code], "\n\n")

  # --- Membership (not applicable to the Floor) ---------------------------
  if (code != "floor") {
    members <- senators |>
      filter(grepl(code, Committee)) |>
      mutate(
        Role = case_when(
          !is.na(Chair) & Chair == code ~ "Chair",
          !is.na(Vice.Chair) & Vice.Chair == code ~ "Vice Chair",
          TRUE ~ "Member"
        ),
        Senator = sprintf("[%s](%s/district_%s.html)", Name, SENATOR_PAGES_DIR, District)
      ) |>
      arrange(factor(Role, levels = c("Chair", "Vice Chair", "Member")), Last.Name) |>
      select(Senator, Role, Party, District)

    if (nrow(members) > 0) {
      cat(kable(members, format = "pipe"), sep = "\n")
      cat("\n\n")
    } else {
      cat("*Committee assignments have not been made yet.*\n\n")
    }
  }

  # --- Latest agenda -------------------------------------------------------
  mine <- sort(agenda_files[startsWith(agenda_files, paste0(code, "_"))], decreasing = TRUE)
  # Filenames sort by name, not date; parse dates to find the real latest
  if (length(mine) > 0) {
    dates <- as.Date(gsub("^[a-z]+_(\\d+)_(\\d+)_(\\d+)\\.pdf$", "20\\3-\\1-\\2", mine))
    mine <- mine[order(dates, decreasing = TRUE)]
    cat(sprintf("**Latest agenda:** [%s](%s/%s)\n\n",
                format(max(dates, na.rm = TRUE), "%B %d, %Y"), AGENDAS_DIR, mine[1]))
    if (length(mine) > 1) {
      cat('<details><summary>Earlier agendas</summary>\n\n')
      cat(sprintf("- [%s](%s/%s)\n",
                  format(sort(dates, decreasing = TRUE)[-1], "%B %d, %Y"),
                  AGENDAS_DIR, mine[-1]), sep = "")
      cat("\n</details>\n\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("*No agendas filed yet.*\n\n")
  }

  # --- Docket: bills awaiting action here ---------------------------------
  docket <- if (code == "floor") {
    bills |> filter(status == "To Floor")
  } else if (code == "app") {
    bills |> filter(status == "To Appropriations")
  } else {
    bills |> filter(committee_code %in% code, status == "In Committee")
  }

  cat("### Docket\n\n")
  if (nrow(docket) > 0) {
    docket_tbl <- docket |>
      mutate(Bill = sprintf("[%s](%s/%s.html)", bill_measure, BILL_PAGES_DIR, url_slug)) |>
      select(Bill, Subject = title, Author = name, Fiscal = appropriations)
    cat(kable(docket_tbl, format = "pipe"), sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("*Nothing currently awaiting action.*\n\n")
  }

  # --- Recent votes --------------------------------------------------------
  if (!is.null(votes[[code]])) {
    recent <- votes[[code]] |>
      arrange(desc(Date)) |>
      head(5) |>
      left_join(bills |> select(bill_measure, url_slug), by = c("Bill" = "bill_measure")) |>
      mutate(Bill = ifelse(is.na(url_slug), Bill,
                           sprintf("[%s](%s/%s.html)", Bill, BILL_PAGES_DIR, url_slug)),
             Date = format(Date, "%b %d")) |>
      select(Date, Bill, Vote, Result)
    cat("### Recent votes\n\n")
    cat(kable(recent, format = "pipe"), sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}

cat(":::\n")
```
